title: Aureline M5 selected-change binding
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a selected-change binding: the binding surfaced before any broad-scope flow (a broad refactor, a migration / import, a scaffold / update flow, or a provider-backed mutation) so a bounded working change is never applied against ambient branch state. Names the object class, its change-orchestration association, the broad flow it gates, the selected change object it is bound to, and the explicit worktree / base identity that must be present before the flow can begin — so no worktree is mutated without an explicit selected change object and binding, and no broad-scope flow lands from ambient branch state. Downstream the patch-stack / queue, change-object detail, provider-landing, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating selected-change-binding behavior by hand. Raw paths, raw provider payloads, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
